overall: The AG found no violation: the executive session topic was not reasonably anticipated by the chair 48 hours ahead, and the stated executive session purpose gave sufficient detail.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to timely list an executive session topic (principal contract negotiations) in the notice for its June 12, 2012 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because Chair Thorp did not reasonably anticipate that the Committee would discuss the contract offers 48 hours before the June 12, 2012 meeting, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee's stated purpose for entering executive session on administrator contracts was not detailed enough to notify the public.
allegations.key_passage: This level of detail was sufficient to notify the public as to why the Committee entered into executive session.
